name: Turbolearn
summary: Study app that turns lectures, PDFs and videos into notes, flashcards and quizzes.
description: Turbolearn, also called Turbo AI, turns study materials such as PDFs, videos, slides and lecture recordings into notes, flashcards, quizzes and other activities. It runs on the web and in a mobile app, and the site states it is free to start. No pricing page could be read during this check. The site reports more than ten million learners. Files can be dropped in directly, and the app generates study materials from them.
